opening.argument: The presentation walks through a concrete scraping workflow: the speaker explains pagination, XPath expressions, extraction actions and how to start the configured task. The screens show an Octoparse interface alongside eBay product listings and selected data fields. These details establish an instructional demonstration of extracting product information, rather than a request for payment, credentials or financial participation. The description's trial and website invitations are consistent with software promotion accompanying the tutorial; they do not change the subject of the demonstration or establish any financial outcome.
